column1: # The v0.9.0 release notes' ERROR claims: the cells whose "now" column says the
# program stops instead of answering. One per line:
#   <substring the diagnostic must contain>
# Tab-separated, `#` comments ignored. Each program must exit NON-ZERO and its
# stderr must contain the substring. Both halves matter: an exit code without the
# message is a program that failed for some other reason. Each program is ONE line,
# because that is how the runner writes them — and the substring must not begin with
# `-`, because the runner greps for it.
# --- PostgreSQL is behind `--features postgres`, and the notes say the verb still
# --- exists, describes itself and type-checks everywhere — only the body is gated
# --- (ADR 0032). A default binary saying so IS the claim.
no PostgreSQL support
no PostgreSQL support
# --- "a name nothing provides is still an error, with its did-you-mean intact" —
# --- the sentence the receiver-directed rule is careful not to cost.
has no method `nonesuch`
# --- "a verb the receiver does not have is refused the same way on every engine",
# --- which the notes list among the wording divergences closed. The receiver is a
# --- LAMBDA PARAMETER on purpose: the checker cannot prove it, so these reach the
# --- run-time dispatch the claim is about rather than being rejected before it.
a DataFrame has no method `map`
no aggregation `sort`
